# fjordrun_team_member (Resource)

The role of an existing team member. The API has no way to add someone directly: people join by accepting an invite (`fjordrun_team_invite`). Creating this resource **adopts** an existing member and sets their role; it fails if the person isn't a member yet. Destroying it **removes the person from the team**.

Only owners can grant or revoke the owner role, and a team keeps at least one owner.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "team_id" {
  type = string
}

# Ana already accepted an invite. This sets her role; destroying it removes her from the team.
resource "fjordrun_team_member" "ana" {
  team_id = var.team_id
  email   = "ana@example.com"
  role    = "admin"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `role` (String) `owner`, `admin`, `member` or `viewer`.
- `team_id` (String) Team ID.

### Optional

- `email` (String) The member's email address. Set this or `user_id`.
- `user_id` (String) The member's user ID. Set this or `email`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `team_id/user_id`.
- `joined_at` (String) When they joined the team.
- `name` (String) The member's name.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# team_id/user_id
terraform import fjordrun_team_member.ana 11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111/22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222
```
